title: greenhorn config
description: Reader profiles and limits for the greenhorn plugin. Every number below is an untested default. No study backs 5 terms, 3 uses or 25 words. The human eval in eval/README.md is how they get tuned, and until it runs they are guesses. Limits layer in this order: built-in defaults, the top-level limits, then the limits of the chosen profile.

profile.description: The profile to use. It must be a key of profiles when profiles is set. Built-in presets in the example file: smart-outsider, adjacent-engineer (default), new-hire.

verify.description: The verify pass of /greenhorn:explain: a second, fresh model reader reads the final text. It counts which stumbles of the first reading come back. It does not measure clarity for a person. Costs one extra reader call per run, and one more when a fix round runs.

enabled.description: Run the verify pass. Untested default.

maxRounds.description: Most fix rounds that the verify pass may start. The rounds share the cap of 3 of the lint loop. Untested default.

limits.description: Untested defaults. See the schema description.

maxTerms.description: Most terms one text defines before the too-many-terms warning. Untested default.

glossaryThreshold.description: A term used this many times earns a glossary block. Also the count at which an undefined repeated name raises a warning. Untested default.

maxDefinitionWords.description: Most words in one definition before the long-definition warning. Untested default.

requireExample.description: When true, a text with no example fails the no-example check.

analogyNeedsLimit.description: When true, an analogy with no stated limit raises a warning.

description.description: Who the reader is, in one or two sentences. The stumble reader gets this text.

doesNotKnow.description: What the reader has never seen.
